title: GitHub bans security researcher who posted zero-day Windows exploits
summary: GitHub banned a security researcher for posting Windows zero-day exploits, sparking controversy over the appropriateness of the action. Security experts claim the ban is vindictive and that Microsoft/GitHub's response will prompt further retaliation from the research community.
problem_solved: This news article addresses the ongoing ethical debate around responsible disclosure practices and the treatment of security researchers by major tech platforms.
why_valuable: It highlights the tension between bug bounty programs, responsible disclosure policies, and the autonomy of security researchers who expose vulnerabilities.
